reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Productivity
reading.passage: Remote work has fundamentally transformed how companies operate in the 21st century. Studies show that employees working from home demonstrate increased productivity levels, particularly in roles requiring deep concentration. However, the lack of face-to-face interaction can hinder team collaboration and company culture development. Organizations must balance flexibility with structured communication protocols to maximize benefits while minimizing isolation effects. The future of work likely involves hybrid models combining remote and office environments.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is a potential disadvantage of remote work?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '원격 근무의 단점은 대면 상호작용의 부족'이라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What solution does the passage suggest for remote work challenges?
options: Hybrid models combining remote and office
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 하이브리드 모델을 미래의 업무 형태로 제시하고 있습니다.

questions.q: Which group of employees benefits most from remote work according to the passage?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '깊은 집중력이 필요한 역할에서 원격 근무자들의 생산성이 높다'고 설명합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement: Remote work is more productive than working in an office environment?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시. 예: 'I agree that remote work can be more productive than office work because...' 또는 'I disagree with the statement that...'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유와 구체적 예시 제공. 각 문장이 명확하고 논리적으로 연결되어야 함.
structure.body2: 상반된 의견을 인정하면서도 자신의 입장을 강화하는 추가 근거 제시.
structure.conclusion: 입장을 재확인하고 전체 논의를 요약. 새로운 정보는 추가하지 않기.

useful_phrases: However, it should be noted that

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in an office environment where they can collaborate with colleagues. Others prefer working remotely from home. Which do you prefer and why?
sample_points: 원격 근무의 유연성과 개인적 집중력 향상 - 방해 없이 자신의 페이스대로 일할 수 있으며, 통근 시간 절약으로 더 많은 시간을 생산적으로 활용할 수 있음
대면 협업의 중요성 - 팀 동료와의 즉각적인 상호작용으로 아이디어 교환이 활발해지고, 회사 문화 형성과 새로운 직원의 온보딩이 더 효과적임

listening.title: 학생과 교수의 원격 학습 상담
listening.script: Student: Professor, I'm struggling with the transition to online classes. I find it hard to stay focused without the classroom environment. Professor: I understand your concern. Many students experience this adjustment period. However, online learning has several advantages. First, you can review recorded lectures multiple times. Second, you have more flexibility to study at your own pace. Have you tried creating a dedicated study space at home? Student: Not really, I usually study on my bed. Professor: That might be part of the problem. Try setting up a specific area with minimal distractions. Also, don't hesitate to use office hours—I'm available via video chat. Most importantly, stay organized and create a study schedule. These strategies have helped many students succeed in online environments. Student: Thank you, Professor. I'll try implementing these suggestions.

questions.q: What is the student's main concern about online classes?
options: The course material is too difficult
Finding it hard to stay focused without classroom environment
questions.explanation: 학생이 처음으로 '교실 환경 없이 집중하기 어렵다'고 명시적으로 언급했습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as an advantage of online learning?
questions.explanation: 교수는 온라인 학습의 장점으로 강의 재시청, 자신의 페이스로 학습 가능, 유연한 일정을 언급했지만, '더 나은 성적'은 언급하지 않았습니다.

questions.q: What does the professor suggest as a practical solution?
options: Create a dedicated study space at home
questions.explanation: 교수는 '집에서 방해 요소가 적은 특정 공간을 만들 것'을 구체적으로 제안했습니다.
